summary: The guest, unconvinced, points across the room and asks about the smoke.
framing: Medium close-up, chest up, eye level; purple door behind him, blue door frame and green wall at the right edge. Static.

cast.costume: navy suit, white shirt, red tie, red pocket square

props: purple door and blue door frame behind him

beats.action: stands square, arms down, scowling: lids half lowered with a slanted brow line, pupils to the right, mouth clamped in a downturned line; held
starts speaking; head makes small nods and shifts with the words, scowl unchanged
mouth closes; screen-right shoulder and elbow start to lift
screen-right hand rises into frame at the bottom
hand up under his chin, fingers curled, mouth a small o
hand flicks out beside his face, fingers splayed
arm snaps out to screen right, fist with index finger pointing right at shoulder height; held while speaking
jabs the pointing arm further out and down to the right, body leaning with it
holds the point, finger level at chest height near the right edge of frame, still scowling and speaking, to the end of the shot

notes: Camera confirmed static. The pointing arm is the one on screen right (his left). He points off right, toward the stove. He is still speaking on the last frame; the line runs over the cut.
